DESCRIPTION: FIND — `_compute_fix_verdict()` aggregates fix diagnostics by summing across all completely distinct tool categories (`total_net = net_type_errors + net_ruff_errors + net_bandit_issues`). If a fix resolves multiple type errors (-2) but introduces a new security vulnerability via bandit (+1), `total_net` evaluates to -1. The function then returns `SAFE` because `total_net < 0`.
FOLLOW: Downstream, this summation heuristic masks regressions. Defective patches that inject new security flaws or style violations will be categorized as `SAFE` simply because they offset the new issue by resolving existing type issues. The immune system will systematically merge these toxic patches, corrupting codebase health while reporting success.
PROPOSED_FIX: FIX — Check each net error count independently so that any newly introduced issue strictly triggers a `HARMFUL` verdict, regardless of other fixes.
```python

        return "HARMFUL"
        
    total_net = result.net_type_errors + result.net_ruff_errors + result.net_bandit_issues
```
